frame.description: The iframe that holds the Embedded Messaging widget.

classicLauncher.description: In the page: the launcher of the classic widget.

launcher.description: In the frame: the launcher of the newer widget (often labelled Ask Me Anything, named Start with text).

candidates.name: start with text|ask me anything|chat with|let's chat|^chat$

input.description: In the frame: the message box.

idleInput.description: In the frame: the classic widget's input when no conversation is open.

chat.description: In the frame: the scope of click: steps and expect-button checks.

root.description: In the frame: the element the chat reader walks.

agentText.description: In the frame: the text of an agent message (SLDS chat blueprint).

userText.description: In the frame: the text of a message the user sent (SLDS chat blueprint).

event.description: In the frame: system events (joined, left, ended). A new one with no answer is a hand-off.

busy.description: In the frame: anything visible here means the agent is still working.

row.description: In the frame: a whole chat row, scrolled to the top of the chat for a reply's screenshot.

menu.description: In the frame: the chat menu (fresh: true ends a chat left open).

endChat.description: In the frame: the menu item that ends the chat.

confirmEnd.description: In the frame: confirms ending the chat.

newConversation.description: In the frame: starts a new conversation after ending one.
